name: Kocaer Celik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
summary: Kocaer Celik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of iron and steel products in Turkey and internationally. It offers merchant bars, such as equal angle, round, square, T, serrated flat, and flat bars; UB and UC universal beams and columns, W beam, IPE beams, HEA/HEB beams, and IPN profiles; PFC, C, UPN, UAC, CH, and UPE channels; and mining and tunneling steel profiles. The company also provides rasp bars, steel profiles for solar mounting and tracking systems, and underground fortification systems; and window sections.
